# GitHub Copilot Instructions

When working on this project, please adhere to the specialized AI skills located in `.github/skills/`.

## Key Skills:
1. **Mobile-First Strategy**: [mobile-first-strategy.md](skills/mobile-first-strategy.md) - Focus on mobile-first development.
2. **Responsive Components**: [responsive-components.md](skills/responsive-components.md) - Build fluid, adaptive UI components.
3. **Trust & Messaging**: [trust-and-ux.md](skills/trust-and-ux.md) - Maintain professional enterprise-grade trust messaging.
4. **Performance Optimization**: [performance-optimization.md](skills/performance-optimization.md) - Ensure fast loading on mobile devices.

Always prioritize the mobile viewport and maintain professional tone in all UI and copy additions.
